acceptanceCriteria: The unsupported-verify-syntax refusal prints a fix: line that names the allowed syntax.
A test covers a verify line containing ^ or $.
body: Found 2026-09-25 (PR #243 agent). dogfood-change refuses `^` and `$` in DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE lines with unsupported-verify-syntax, but prints no `fix:` line, which DCW-V0-014 requires. The allowed set is at internal/trace/record.go:507 on main at 3c1b894c.
title: dogfood-change refuses ^ and $ in DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE lines without a fix: line (DCW-V0-014)
